program.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: In the edited image, is the mug corresponding to the mug in the source image positioned to the right of the headphones, and does the visual evidence establish whether the requested move is complete?
nodes.criteria: Pass only if the source mug can be identified by visual correspondence in the edited image and is visibly to the right of the headphones, with the requested move complete. Fail if the corresponding source mug is identifiable and the requested move has not been made. Unknown if the mug's identity, its relation to the headphones, or completion of the requested move cannot be determined from the source and edited images; do not infer completion merely because another mug is to the right of the headphones.
nodes.binding: Compare the source image's blue mug with objects in the edited image to identify its corresponding mug, then compare that mug's position with the headphones in the edited image. Consider all visible mug-like objects; if correspondence or completion is ambiguous, use unknown.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

d1: The binding is truncated/underspecified (“objects in (...)”) and should explicitly anchor the comparison to the source and edited images and the requested move. The trace identifies a pale mug near the headphones and another to their right, but treats color mismatch as preventing correspondence and overlooks the strong spatial/shape evidence: the source blue mug appears as a blue, blurred remnant at the far left, while the edited image also contains mug-like objects on both sides of the headphones. Assess whether the original mug remains at its source location and whether either candidate plausibly represents it; distinguish evidence of partial movement from evidence that the move is complete. Do not equate any mug right of the headphones with the source mug, or infer absence solely from altered color/appearance. Preserve unknown when correspondence genuinely cannot be resolved, but make the criterion state how to evaluate partial progress and completion separately so the node does not collapse ambiguity into unresolved. The high-confidence unknown is a visual-criterion/calibration issue, not a transport or dependency failure; the aggregate reference label “partial” is a constraint, not atomic ground truth.

observations.evidence: The source contains a distinctive blue mug to the left of the headphones. In the edited image, there are two mug-like objects: a pale mug near the left side of the headphones and a mug to their right. Neither visibly matches the source mug's blue appearance, and the source mug may be absent or altered; the correspondence cannot be established confidently, so it is unclear whether the requested move is complete.

findings.criteria: Compare distinctive shape, handle orientation, color/appearance, and scene position across the images; do not treat a mug's right-side position alone as proof it is the source mug. If correspondence remains indeterminate, retain unknown.
findings.evidence: The source shows one light-blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image shows two pale mugs, one left and one right of the headphones, plus a blue-looking blurred patch left of them; neither mug is an obvious visual match to the source mug.
findings.rationale: The saved check already notes uncertain correspondence, but does not separately investigate whether the blue patch or other visual details support matching the source mug to either edited mug. This finer correspondence check is needed to judge the requested move without assuming that the right-side mug is the moved mug.

transactions.reason: The existing check conflates identifying the source mug, detecting partial movement, and deciding whether the requested final position is achieved. Replace it with a single requirement-mapped decision that explicitly evaluates those separately, including the visible source-location remnant and both edited mug candidates, without assuming either candidate is the original mug or using the reference label as a criterion.

decisions.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the source mug's requested move to the right of the headphones complete, incomplete with visible progress, or not made?
decisions.criteria: Pass only if visual correspondence establishes that the source mug is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, satisfying the requested move. Fail if the source mug is identifiable and remains at its source-side position with no visible progress toward the right, or if it is identifiable in an intermediate position and the requested final position is not achieved. If the source mug is identifiable and evidence shows it remains at the source location while a plausible corresponding mug has appeared or moved toward the right, treat the move as incomplete rather than complete. Do not count an unrelated mug on the right as completion. Use unknown only when the source mug's correspondence or its position/progress cannot be determined from the images.
decisions.binding: Compare the source image's light-blue mug—including its body shape, handle, appearance, and original position left of the headphones—with all mug-like objects and any visible remnants in the edited image. Assess the pale mug left of the headphones, the mug right of them, and the blue-looking blurred patch at the far left as possible correspondence evidence; altered color or appearance alone does not rule out identity. Determine whether the source mug is still at its original location, has plausibly moved toward the right, or is visibly to the right of the headphones. Base the decision on source-to-edited visual evidence and the requested move, not on mug count or right-side position alone; retain unknown if correspondence or progress remains genuinely indeterminate.
